rounds.story: Ligama lisuselwa esiGrekini. Tele lisho khashane, phone lisho umsindvo. Ngako ithelefoni iletsa livi lisuka kude.
Leli gama lihlanganisa imphandze yemagama lamabili. Lichaza kubona tintfo letivela kude uhleli ekhaya.
Mikros lisho lincane, skopein lisho kubuka. Imikroskopu isita kubona tintfo letincane kakhulu.
Tele lisho khashane, skopein lisho kubuka. Itheliskhopu yenta emehlo akho afike etintfweni letikhashane.
Helix lisho lokujikako, pteron lisho liphiko. Ngako ihelikhophtha inemaphephelo ajikako emoyeni.
Phos lisho kukhanya, graphein lisho kubhala. Ifothografi ifana nekubhala sitfombe ngekukhanya.
Ge lisho umhlaba, graphein lisho kubhala. Ijografi isifundvo lesibhalela futsi sichaze umhlaba.
Bios lisho imphilo, logia lisho lwati noma sifundvo. Ibhayoloji ifundza tintfo letiphilako.
Demos lisho bantfu, kratos lisho emandla. Idemokhrasi ngumbuso lapho livi lebantfu libalulekile.
Philo lisho lutsandvo, sophia lisho inhlakanipho. Ifilosofi ifuna kucondza imicabango nemphilo.

kids.story: Kadzeni skhole besisho kuphumula. Emuva laba ligama lendzawo lapho bantfwana bafundza khona.
Radius usho umsebe. Irediyo yatiwa ngekutfumela umsindvo emoyeni njengemisebe.
Bi lisho kubili. Ligama lisho intfo lenemasondvo lamabili. Yingakho libhayisikili lime kanjalo.
Camera kadzeni besiligumbi. Namuhla ikhamera yigcina sitfombe ngaphakathi kwayo.
Video esiLatinini kusho ngiyabona. Ividiyo yintfo loyibukako ngemehlo.
Kinema kusho kunyakata. Isinema yacala ngemitfombe lebeyinyakata.
Calendae bekulilusuku lwekucala lwenyanga. Likhalenda lisita kubala tinsuku.
Robota kwakusho umsebenti lophocelelwe. Namuhla irobhothi yintfo leyenta imisebenti.
Diarium lihlobene nelusuku. Idayari yincwadzi lebhalwa lokwenteka nsuku tonkhe.
Khilioi kusho inkhulungwane, metron kusho kukala. Ikhilomitha yindlela yekukala libanga.
